# AI Stupid Level SDKs

Official clients for the AI Stupid Level Smart Router, an
OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Each request g

oes to the model measuring best for that kind of work,
based on benchmarks that are re-run continuou
sly. You call it with your own provider keys.

ider` | packages/ai-sdk-provider |

l/mcp` | packages/mcp |

`openapi/router-v1.json` describes the API in OpenAPI 3.1, for generating a
client in any other lang
uage. The live copy is at <https://aistupidlevel.info/v1/openapi.json>.

## Why use an SDK instead of an OpenAI client
Any OpenAI client works against `https://aistupidlevel.info/v1`. The SDKs add:

- **Routing info** on every answer and stream: the model and provider that answered, why they were
c

hosen, and whether a fallback answered.
- **Safe retries.** An automatic `Idempotency-Key` means a r

equest is answered once, even if it is
retried.
- **Typed errors** with `party` and `retryable`. An

app can tell its user to top up, to fix a
provider key, or simply to try again.
- `runTools` / `run_

tools`, a tool-calling loop that stays on one model.
- **Sandbox mode** (mock answers through real r
outing, at no cost), route previews, and usage.
See the API documentation.

## Releasing

1. Bump the version in every place it appears:
- `packages/router/package.json` and `packages/router

/src/core.ts`;
- `packages/ai-sdk-provider/package.json` and `packages/ai-sdk-provider/src/index.ts`

;
- `packages/mcp/package.json`, `packages/mcp/src/config.ts` and both versions in `packages/mcp/ser

ackage directory. `prepublishOnly` builds the package
and runs its tests first.
3. PyPI: `cd python

&& python -m build && twine upload dist/*`.
4. MCP Registry, after the npm release of `@aistupidleve

l/mcp`: `cd packages/mcp && mcp-publisher login github && mcp-publisher publish`.
5. n8n node: relea

sed from its own repository,
StudioPlatforms/n8n-nodes-aistupidlevel, by a `v<version>` tag.
6. Rayc

ast: from `integrations/raycast/aistupidlevel`, `npm run publish` opens a pull request to
raycast/ex

tensions.
7. Pi: `cd packages/pi-provider && npm publish` (Node 22.19+). Push first: the pi.dev gall

ery image is
read from `main`. The `pi-package` keyword lists it on pi.dev/packages; there is nothin

g to submit.
8. Langflow: bump `langflow-python/pyproject.toml`, `src/lfx_aistupidlevel/__init__.py`

and
`src/lfx_aistupidlevel/extension.json` (a test checks they match), then
`cd langflow-python &&
uv build && twine upload dist/*` with twine 7 or later.
